Seocho-dong () is a dong (neighbourhood) of Seocho District, Seoul, South Korea.
Seocho-dong is divided into 4 different dong which are Seocho 1-dong, 2-dong, 3-dong and 4-dong.
There is Gangnam Station in Seocho-dong, which is one of the biggest stations in Korea.
